OVERVIEW
 Post videos using the provided ForgeGUI footage with a little bit of editing.
Content must feel natural, clean, and organic.

ForgeGUI is an AI tool for developers and Creators that creates thumbnails, 3D models, GUIs, skins, Scripting (Coding) and other assets. The goal is to show off the tool to Roblox or Fortnite developers through YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels.

STEP ONE: ACCOUNT SETUP
 • Must use a fully Roblox based-account
• You can use accounts you already own
• If you do not already own a roblox account, create a new channel
• The account must look clean, realistic, and organic. Not spam
• Required account bio: “The Best AI Tool for Roblox Devs > forgegui.com”

WARMUP PROCESS
 Day 1
• Scroll FYP normally
• Do not search anything
• Act like a real user

Day 2
• Search your niche (Roblox dev, Roblox AI softwares, etc.)
• Engage with a few related videos
• Continue normal scrolling

Day 3
• Fully engage with your niche

After Day 3
• Start posting
• Engage at least 15 minutes daily

Skipping warmup = weak reach.



STEP TWO: CONTENT REPURPOSING
You will be given pre-made ForgeGUI videos/footage to repurpose and upload.

You are not expected to create full videos from scratch. Your job is to make the provided footage feel native to the platform by adding simple edits.

You can repurpose the videos by adding:

  • Add captions or text on screen

  • Slight trimming or pacing changes

  • Simple zooms, cuts, or transitions

  • Music is recommended
  • Do not upload the provided footage with no changes

STEP THREE: CONTENT FORMAT
 • Use the provided ForgeGUI footage [Assets]
• Simple UGC style
• Keep content minimal and easy to understand
• Avoid aggressive promotion
• Show ForgeGUI clearly

UPLOAD REQUIREMENTS
 • You must join the BloxClips discord server: https://discord.gg/fTrmC7dNb 
 • Likes, comments, and shares must be turned on and public
• 40%+ of your audience must be Tier 1
 • Remove the verification code from your bio after verifying with content rewards
• Must have at least 10 likes per 1,000 views ratio
• Tiktok promotion and/any sort of un-organic algorithm view methods are not allowed. 
• Spamming uploads/submissions will get you banned
• Botters will be permanently IP banned
 • Call to action mentioning ForgeGUI and showing the logo for at least 3 seconds. Can be at the end of the video. Something along the lines of "Try ForgeGUI today" or "Tool is called ForgeGUI" 
• You cannot use alternate accounts to like your posts or engage in “like for like” to boost engagement. Same goes for commenting
• Do not post more than 3 times per day on one account or else you may get shadowbanned. Make a new account if you want to post more

QUALITY AND APPROVAL STANDARDS

• Content with little original effort may be rejected.
• Clips need to highlight ForgeGUI features. An actual demo is required.
• Misleading, low-quality, poorly presented, or off-topic submissions may be denied.
• Bait and switch content will be denied. This is when the hook is unrelated to the rest of the video
• Paid promotions and collaborations are not allowed and will be rejected

COMMENTS & DESCRIPTION

Each submission must include a natural comment + description mentioning ForgeGUI. Such as “I used ForgeGUI”
The comment must be pinned if the platform allows it.


HASHTAGS:
Must use all three in this order: #forgeguipartner #robloxdev #roblox

Every post MUST include one of the following disclosures somewhere in the caption: #forgeguipartner


Placement rules:

  • Must be the first hashtag or element after the post text
  • Must use all three in this order: #forgeguipartner #robloxdev #roblox
  • Must not be buried in a paragraph, must be clear and conspicuous
